## projects / Stayro

URL: https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/stayro

Stayro
Guest and host mobile apps for stays in Saudi Arabia.

- 2 apps guest + host
- team of 2 that I led
- 3 national integrations

role: engineering lead, mobile and infra
where: Eignspaces · 2025–26
stack: React Native · Expo · EAS · GitHub Actions · GCP · Celery · Redis
contributions

- led two developers to refine, debug and scale both apps
- integrated Nafath national identity, Ministry of Tourism compliance and secure payments
- built CI/CD with GitHub Actions and EAS, so builds go straight to the App Store
- set up GCP: Cloud Run, Cloud SQL and Redis behind an async Celery backend

## projects / Hivo

URL: https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/hivo

Hivo
Mobile-first rental marketplace for Saudi Arabia.

- ★ 5.0 App Store rating
- 800+ listings after host launch
- paced host onboarding, from demand

role: full-stack · unit management system · mentor
where: Eignspaces · 2025–26
stack: React Native · Expo · Node.js · PostgreSQL

context
Global booking platforms lacked cultural relevance, trust signals and smooth bilingual flows for Saudi travelers and hosts. Hivo answers with localized discovery, bilingual flows, secure payments and fast booking.
contributions

- owned the unit management system and core marketplace screens, end to end
- worked closely with project managers and designers on pixel-perfect UI
- mentored interns on React Native and Expo
- brought AI-assisted workflows with Cursor to the team
→ App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hivo-%D9%87%D9%8A%DA%A4%D9%88/id6757620973

## projects / Reconciled

URL: https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/reconciled

Reconciled
Invoice reconciliation platform for staffing agencies.

- acquired by LaborEdge, as the flagship
- −40% technical debt
- 6 countries on the team

role: frontend systems · analytics · UI/UX gaps
where: Eignspaces, with Herwin Software · 2024–25
stack: React · Next.js · Node.js · PostgreSQL · Segment · Mixpanel · Hotjar

context
Manual invoice reconciliation across VMS systems caused errors, delays and lost revenue. Reconciled automates invoice matching, flags discrepancies and streamlines the whole process.
contributions

- built scalable React components from Figma, for a more consistent UI
- set up product analytics with Segment, Mixpanel and Hotjar
- refactored steadily to cut technical debt by 40%
- shipped business features directly with the CFO and engineering leadership
- mentored juniors and interns on React, Next.js and design patterns
what they said

## projects / Outlined AI

URL: https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/outlined-ai

Outlined AI
AI mobile app that turns audio and video into structured notes.

- 4 outputs: transcript, summary, notes, questions
- lead end to end

role: development lead
where: Nodogoro · 2023
stack: React Native · Node.js · OpenAI · Whisper · FFmpeg
context
Getting insights out of audio and video is slow. Outlined AI extracts the transcript, then gives you a summary, notes and the common questions, in one mobile app.

## projects / Sharp Studio

URL: https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/sharp-studio

Sharp Studio
Hackable image processing: convert, resize and compress.

- solo design to deploy
- pipelines you configure

stack: React · Node.js · TypeScript · Sharp
context
Existing image tools are rigid and hard to customize. Sharp Studio is a web tool with configurable pipelines, many formats and precise control over output.

## projects / Editor Setup

URL: https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/projects/editor-setup

Editor Setup
Curated VS Code font and theme pairings.

- 8 hand-picked pairings
- solo design to deploy
- static near-zero latency

stack: Next.js · React · TypeScript · Netlify
context
Developers spend hours on Reddit, blogs and GitHub looking for a theme and font that work together. Editor Setup gives 8 pairings, each with a code preview and one-click install links.
“Finally, someone paired JetBrains Mono with One Dark Pro — looks amazing”
community feedback

## about

URL: https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/about

About
Full-stack engineer in Tanta, Egypt, with 7+ years building single-page apps, mobile apps and RESTful APIs.
I grew up around computers and wrote my first code in preparatory school, in Visual Basic.NET. These days I care most about the part people touch, and I'm growing toward design engineering. See experience for where, and principles for how.
mentorship
I mentor junior and mid-level engineers and interns on React, React Native, Next.js and design patterns, and I've trained teams on AI-assisted workflows with Cursor.
education

2022–23: MSE, Software Engineering · Arizona State University · 4.0 GPA · AGFE OLS scholarship
2014–19: BSc, Computer Engineering · The American University in Cairo · Egyptian Public Schools scholarship
courses: McKinsey Forward Program (2024) · Udacity Advanced Full-Stack (2022) · Udacity React (2022)
hackathons: Hajj Hackathon, Jeddah (2018): Kun 3awnan, IoT help for pilgrims · Dell EMC 423x (2019)
off the clock

reading: History, technology and long-form essays.
writing: Product decisions and lessons from shipping, on Hashnode.
exploring: New tools and side projects.
life: Family and football. Recently married, so learning that renovating an apartment is a very different kind of engineering.

## principles

URL: https://som3aware.pages.dev/#/principles

How I work

- 01 Simplicity in complexity
Make complex systems feel simple, intuitive, and effortless to use without losing depth.
- 02 Attention to detail
Treat small details as meaningful decisions. They often define the difference between good and great products.
- 03 Interface craftsmanship
Build pixel-perfect interfaces where spacing, structure, and interaction feel intentional and consistent.
- 04 Engineering quality
Balance speed with maintainability. Ship fast without creating fragile systems.
- 05 Writing & knowledge sharing
Share engineering and product thinking through writing, to transfer knowledge and reflect on real-world experience.
- 06 Mentorship & growth
Help junior and mid-level engineers grow through guidance, feedback, and practical engineering insight.
